svg.title: DreamerV3: state learning, imagined behavior, and deployment
svg.desc: Detailed art-direction study. Recurrent memory feeds both the categorical prior and observation-conditioned posterior. The posterior sample and memory form the state used by observation, reward, and continuation heads. Balanced KL terms train prior and posterior with separate stop-gradient directions. Imagined trajectories use the prior and actor, and predicted rewards, continuation, and critic values supply lambda-return targets. The deployed actor uses the inferred state. Illustrative dimensions and scenes, not a model output or measurement.
svg.text: Learning a world. Learning to act inside it.
State inference, model objectives, and imagined behavior shown as separate computations.
One observed step. The posterior sees the image; the prior must predict without it.
z is a collection of categorical variables.
The small grid is illustrative, not its tensor size.
sg stops the gradient. KL balancing uses opposite stop-gradient directions; free-nats clipping is omitted here.
Imagine trajectories, then improve the actor and critic
Start from an inferred state. Future steps use the prior and actions sampled from the policy.
new observation → update posterior state → sample actor action → environment → next observation
The observation decoder supports learning; the deployed actor chooses actions from the inferred state.
Original explanatory artwork • Feature grids and scenes are schematic • Loss weights, normalizers and layer widths omitted.
Sources: DreamerV3 project; official agent.py (loss, imag_loss, policy); rssm.py (observe, imagine, loss). Checked 10 Oct 2026.
